csv_scope_of_work: The U.S Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Philadelphia District (NAP) is issuing this Sources Sought Announcement for the award of one Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) providing Architect/Engineer (A/E) Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) of MultiDiscipline A/E services primarily for the design of vertical construction facilities.

title: Design for Vertical Construction
short_description: USACE seeks multidisciplinary A/E services for design of vertical construction facilities.
project_scope: Sources sought for one multiple-award task order contract (MATOC) as an architect/engineer IDIQ for multidisciplinary design services primarily for vertical construction facilities. Up to 3 contracts may be awarded. Total program construction cost is stated as 100.0M-250.0M USD. No specific building types, sizes, gross floor areas, or structural characteristics are provided.
services: Multidisciplinary architect/engineer services for design of vertical construction facilities under an IDIQ/MATOC arrangement.
relevance_explanation:
- General vertical construction A/E IDIQ without a defined specific project or structural challenge.
- Framework-style multiple-award contract with broad scope and no clear technical specification.
- Could include building structures, but no indication of long-span, special structures, sports, bridges, or architecturally demanding projects.
- Early-stage sources sought notice only, reducing immediate strategic value for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender documents based on the stated total construction cost range of 100.0M-250.0M USD; midpoint used.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated. Only total program construction cost range of 100.0M-250.0M USD and IDIQ/MATOC structure are provided; no reliable sbp fee can be derived.
references_qualifications: All disciplines requested. Specific reference or qualification requirements are not stated in the provided notice.
